cite: Wording basis of terrestrial draft letters per kind. The kind is chosen in code from the stored findings (ific.terra.draft.choose_kind), never by the LLM.

review.note: Provisions and wording to be confirmed by the Traficom specialists. Bilateral agreements are named, never quoted: their contents are not in the repository.

coordination_request.subject: request for coordination of land mobile assignments
coordination_request.when: FIN coordination is COORD REQUIRED, or the field strength exceeds the trigger and no FIN coordination is recorded
coordination_request.ask: We therefore request that these assignments be coordinated with the Administration of Finland before they are brought into use, and that the technical characteristics listed in the annex be confirmed.
provisions: RR No. 6.7 (agreements between administrations, recorded in the notice as the coordination provision)
the coordination procedure of the applicable ECC criterion

enquiry.subject: technical enquiry on coordinated land mobile assignments
enquiry.when: the field strength exceeds the trigger while FIN coordination is recorded as COORD COMPLETED
enquiry.ask: We would be grateful if you could confirm that the characteristics notified correspond to those coordinated with the Administration of Finland.
provisions: informal technical enquiry, not a reply under an RR comment provision

basis.ecc: The field strength is assessed against {criterion}, which is {applicability} for the notifying administration.
basis.governing: The governing basis for coordination between our administrations is the {governing}; the ECC criterion is quoted as indicative only.
basis.ge06: Assignments notified under the GE06 Regional Agreement are subject to its Article 4 procedure.
